additional_concerns: The candidate's allocation, actual-authority and consistent-conduct test is an interpretive proposal, not an express sufficiency test in paragraph 10. Whether supervisory discharge is required remains unresolved; neither nominal allocation nor a service failure alone settles retained accountability.
No arrangement-specific facts or executable meaning are supplied. The UNFORMALIZED tool result establishes no legal premise or correspondence.

Paragraph 14 distinguishes confirmation from demonstration upon SFC request and requires demonstration to the SFC's satisfaction. Footnote 5 supplies minimum content but leaves a rival unqualified-demonstration reading unresolved. Absence of a request does not establish fulfillment of underlying duties.
Paragraphs 15 and 16 separately condition obtaining third-party verification and a satisfactory legal opinion on SFC request. Neither procurement establishes retained accountability by itself.

The supplied intermediary due-diligence and controls provisions have their own actor and activity conditions. They cannot automatically supply the Product Provider's supervisory standard. Applicable Appendix factors, footnote 2 and complete paragraphs 10–13 remain missing where broader fulfillment is assessed.
